If Windows stops the first start with "Windows protected your PC": MZGram is not signed with a paid certificate. Check that the zip came from this page, then either right-click the zip, Properties, tick Unblock, OK before unpacking, or run `Get-ChildItem -Recurse "C:\path\to\MZGram" | Unblock-File` in PowerShell after unpacking (as administrator for a folder in Program Files), or press More info, Run anyway. Windows protection stays on. Updates MZGram installs itself are not stopped.
